command:
set -euo pipefail
BRANCH=work/photomap-straighten-20260912
CURRENT=2cac09b83eda4b485111561ea3fc3b2485b352a9
GREEN=fe12ac384fb23d6cc3432f14a3828937768733e7
git fetch origin "$BRANCH"
test "$(git rev-parse origin/$BRANCH)" = "$CURRENT"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
git merge --ff-only origin/$BRANCH
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$CURRENT"
git restore --source="$GREEN" -- frontend/src/components/admin/PhotoQueue.tsx frontend/src/components/admin/PhotoQueueItem.tsx
rm -f frontend/e2e/visual/admin-photo-cover-mutation-lock.spec.ts
git diff --check
git diff --quiet "$GREEN" -- frontend/src/components/admin/PhotoQueue.tsx frontend/src/components/admin/PhotoQueueItem.tsx frontend/e2e/visual/admin-photo-cover-mutation-lock.spec.ts
git diff --quiet "$GREEN"
git add frontend/src/components/admin/PhotoQueue.tsx frontend/src/components/admin/PhotoQueueItem.tsx frontend/e2e/visual/admin-photo-cover-mutation-lock.spec.ts
git commit -m 'Revert unreachable photo queue cover lock'
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD^{tree})" = "$(git rev-parse $GREEN^{tree})"
git push origin HEAD:"$BRANCH"
NEW_SHA=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
git fetch origin "$BRANCH"
test "$(git rev-parse origin/$BRANCH)" = "$NEW_SHA"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
printf 'published_sha=%s\n' "$NEW_SHA"
